snippets.snippet: Revised 08.12 .2 0 23 Certificate of Compliance Guideline Through the process described below, the City Commission of Seneca Gardens grants “Certificates of Compliance” to homeowners making alterations and/or additions to their properties. The City of Seneca Gardens is on record with the Louisville Metro Plannin g and Zoning Office. Therefore, a “Certificate of Compliance” must be obtained prior to an application for a building permit from Louisville Metro. The following is a checklist of required items to be submitted for a “Certificate of Compliance.” _____ _ Completed application for a “Certificate of Compliance ______ Permit fee of $ 75 0 (check to be made out to “Seneca Gardens”) ______ Photos of all sides of the house ______ Architectural Drawings - One (1) electronic format (PDF) or Two (2) paper copies of architectural drawings prepared by a professional draftsman or Architect .
